subject: English
question_text: Write a paragraph on 'Good Food' answering the
stimulus: questions below in 100 words. 10 (a) What is food? (b) What is good food? (c) Why do we eat food? (d) How much do we eat at a time? (e) What are the elements of food? SSC English
guide_solution: Paragraph writing Good food Food is something that people and animals eat or plants absorb, to keep them alive. Good food is something which is essential for human body. Good food has nutritious value. Without eating nutritious food one can't find it easier to lead a happier and healthier life. There are carbohydrate, protein, fat, mineral, water which are of paramount importance for our body. Each has its own function to deliver. We generally eat three times a day. Breakfast is for morning and lunch for midday and supper for night. Besides we take snack, junk food, soft drink etc which are not considered to be good food. Moreover, we eat fruits which are not only delicious but also nutritious to eat. We must avoid such food and eat good food in order to lead a healthier life.
source: SSC English 1st Paper Test Paper 85 — Laksam Pilot High School, Comilla
